text:
All Chief Mates, Chief Engineers and Second Engineers operating UK flagged vessels must have knowledge of UKLAP to Grade 2 level.

You do not have to take an exam but it is your employer’s responsibility to make sure you have this knowledge before you start work on board a ship.

This is guidance to all Owners, Masters, Officers, Ratings and those concerned with maritime training. This guidance should be read with How to apply for a FSE for deck and engineer officers and replaces the syllabuses published on UK seafarer careers: Training provision, information and examination syllabuses. This replacement has been made for formatting and accessibility purposes only, no content has been amended during this move.

Please send any feedback to exams@mcga.gov.uk.
